shortDescription: Create, modify or delete a fabric on OpenManage Enterprise Modular

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: description
options.description: Provide a short description of the fabric to be created or modified.

options.name: fabric_design
options.description: Specify the fabric topology.See the use API U(https://www.dell.com/support/manuals/en-in/poweredge-mx7000/omem_1_20_10_ug/smartfabric-network-topologies) to know why its topology. I(fabric_design) is mandatory for fabric creation.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: name
options.description: Provide the I(name) of the fabric to be created, deleted or modified.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Provide the I(name) of the fabric to be modified.

options.name: override_LLDP_configuration
options.description: Enable this configuration to allow Fabric Management Address to be included in LLDP messages. Notes: OpenManage Enterprise Modular 1.0 does not support this option. Some software networking solutions require a single management address to be transmitted by all Ethernet switches to represent the entire fabric. Enable this feature only when connecting to such a solution.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: primary_switch_service_tag
options.description: Service tag of the first switch. I(primary_switch_service_tag) is mandatory for fabric creation. I(primary_switch_service_tag) must belong to the model selected in I(fabric_design).

options.name: secondary_switch_service_tag
options.description: Service tag of the second switch. I(secondary_switch_service_tag) is mandatory for fabric creation. I(secondary_switch_service_tag) must belong to the model selected in I(fabric_design).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates a new fabric or modifies an existing fabric. C(absent) deletes an existing fabric. Notes: The create, modify, or delete fabric operation takes around 15-20 minutes to complete. It is recommended not to start an another operation until the current operation is completed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
